schema.title: Response Search Foods V1 Foods Search Get

get.description: The catalog without exclusions; use `POST /v1/recipes/search` to apply them.

post.description:
The catalog filtered by the user's exclusions (sent per request, never stored).

Recipes with an excluded required ingredient are left out.

Propose one serving adjusted to the meal target. Nothing is stored (D8).

Excluded optional ingredients are left out. A recipe with an excluded
required ingredient answers 409 with the ingredients to substitute first
(see the substitutions endpoint).

get.description:
Ranked substitutes for one ingredient, without exclusions.

Use `POST` on the same path to send the user's exclusions.

post.description:
Ranked substitutes for one ingredient that respect the user's exclusions.

An excluded ingredient gets the fix from the exclusion check (`remove` for
an optional one, else safe substitutes); allergy and strict-intolerance
conflicts are never offered, dislikes are ranked down.
Exchange an Apple identity token for our access and refresh tokens.

Rotate a refresh token. Each one works once; reusing one ends the session.

iOS sends the token in the body and gets the next one in the body. The web
sends no body: the token comes from the HttpOnly cookie, the next one goes
back in the cookie, and the response body carries only the access token.

Sign out this device: revoke its refresh token family and clear the cookie.

Always 204, so it also works with an unknown or already revoked token.

delete.description: Delete the account and all data stored about it. This can't be undone.

post.description: Append consent answers (grant or withdrawal); returns the current state per type.

patch.description:
Mark a meal cooked, eaten or skipped.

Idempotent per ``event_id``: replaying an event (an offline outbox retrying)
returns the slot unchanged. Reusing an event id for a different change is a 409.

post.description: Queue an import. Poll `GET /v1/imports/{id}` until it is `ready` or `failed`.

503.description: The import queue is unavailable; nothing was counted

post.description: Save the preview with the answers as the user's private recipe.

409.description: The import is not ready, or already confirmed

skip.title: Skip
skip.description: Leave this line out of the recipe

grams.title: Grams
grams.description: For the whole recipe; omit to use the line's own amount

must_substitute.title: Must Substitute
must_substitute.description: Keys of the excluded required ingredients

ChangeReason.title: ChangeReason
ChangeReason.description: Why an amount changed: the engine's reasons plus removal for an exclusion.

question.title: Question
question.description: Why we ask, e.g. `which ingredient?`, `how much?`

ConsentsIn.title: ConsentsIn
ConsentsIn.description: Answers from one consent screen, recorded together.

CulinaryRole.title: CulinaryRole
CulinaryRole.description: What an ingredient does in a dish; bounds how the optimizer may change it.

ExclusionCategory.title: ExclusionCategory
ExclusionCategory.description:
The checklist the user sees in onboarding (PRD §7).

Every EU allergen is its own category, with the same value as its
:class:`Allergen`. ``shellfish``, ``meat``, ``dairy`` and ``nuts`` are the
broader groups the checklist also shows; ``other`` is a free-text term the
user types in (see :class:`Exclusion`).

relaxed.title: Relaxed
relaxed.description: Only an intolerance can be relaxed

ExportOut.title: ExportOut
ExportOut.description:
Everything the server stores about the user (GDPR Art. 15 and 20).

The health profile is not here because the server never has it; the app
exports it from the phone (D8).

may_contain.title: May Contain
may_contain.description: Effective "may contain" (trace) allergens, including inherited ones. Never repeats an entry of `allergens`.

trace_status.description: Whether the "may contain" data is known, including inherited status. `unknown`: nobody has checked this food or something it is made from, so any allergen could be a trace (not the same as none); an ALLERGY exclusion never allows it. `none_declared`: checked, no traces. `declared`: checked, listed in `may_contain`.

url.title: Url
url.description: The page to read (`link`), or a shared post's URL kept as the source reference only and never fetched (`text`)

text.title: Text
text.description: Recipe text (`text` only), at most 204800 bytes as UTF-8

error.title: Error
error.description: Why it failed: `no_recipe`, `tdm_opt_out`, `robots_disallowed` and the fetch errors mean the app offers to paste the recipe text instead

InfeasibleOut.title: InfeasibleOut
InfeasibleOut.description: No plan fits the hard constraints: what blocked it and what to change (PRD §8.5).

InvalidBodyOut.title: InvalidBodyOut
InvalidBodyOut.description: FastAPI's validation error, without the submitted values.

carbs_g.title: Carbs G
carbs_g.description: Available carbohydrate, excluding fiber (EU label style)

PersonalizeOut.title: PersonalizeOut
PersonalizeOut.description: A proposal for one serving. Nothing is stored until the user confirms.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Soft goals that had to be relaxed, in plain words

ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn
ProfileIn.description: The parts of the nutrition profile the planner needs (PRD §7).

food.description: The food used in the proposal (the substitute if swapped)

grams.title: Grams
grams.description: Per serving in the proposal; 0 when removed

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.description: Ingredients the request's exclusions affect: `excluded` optional ones are left out when personalizing, `penalised` ones are dislikes. Recipes with an excluded required ingredient are not listed.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.description: Ingredients the request's exclusions affect: `excluded` optional ones are left out when personalizing, `penalised` ones are dislikes. Recipes with an excluded required ingredient are not listed.

Rule.title: Rule
Rule.description: Constraints that the infeasibility diagnosis may switch off one at a time.

Severity.title: Severity
Severity.description: How strongly the user wants to avoid a category (PRD §7).

recipe_id.title: Recipe Id
recipe_id.description: None if the recipe was deleted since

leave_out.title: Leave Out
leave_out.description: Optional ingredient keys to leave out

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Soft exclusions the recipe touches. Only in the response that created the plan: they come from the profile, which is not stored.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: Client-generated, unique per change: a replay with the same id is a no-op

grams.title: Grams
grams.description: Per serving, scaled to do the same job

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.description: The request's exclusions rule this ingredient out

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: Excluded and optional: leaving it out is the fix

grams.title: Grams
grams.description: Amount doing the same job, before adjusting to the target

TraceStatus.title: TraceStatus
TraceStatus.description: What is known about a food's "may contain" (trace) allergens.

Verdict.title: Verdict
Verdict.description: What one exclusion means for one ingredient, from least to most strict.
